diagnosis: ProjectDeliverableListView retrieves deliverables for a given project_pk. Permissions are assigned on EngineeringProject via django-guardian, but the view never verifies if request.user has 'view_engineeringproject' on the parent project before querying child deliverables. Any authenticated contractor who knows or guesses a project_pk can access internal project deliverables and architectural blueprints of other clients.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from guardian.shortcuts import get_objects_for_user
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import ProjectDeliverable, EngineeringProject
from .serializers import ProjectDeliverableSerializer

class ProjectDeliverableListView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, project_pk):
        # Validate that the user holds view permission on the parent project via guardian
        project = get_object_or_404(
            get_objects_for_user(request.user, 'engineering.view_engineeringproject', klass=EngineeringProject),
            pk=project_pk
        )
        deliverables = ProjectDeliverable.objects.filter(project=project)
        serializer = ProjectDeliverableSerializer(deliverables, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
